title: Carry bit
statement: Given Boolean sequences $A$ and $B$, define their carry bit at position $0$ to be false; at position $i+1$, it is true exactly when either both $A_i$ and $B_i$ are true, or exactly one of them is true and the carry bit at position $i$ is true.
